scope: 749 outgoing bay major exterior and independently positioned modules, followed by appropriate reuse in other outdoor bays
photo_review_findings: rear bushing hub distinct from the taller upper-can axis
three fan-like brown bushings with rigid common shape
narrow freestanding control cabinet and open steel supports

pose_protocol.shape_policy: reuse frozen P03 parts; new exterior class hypotheses separately documented from site placement; no per-shed coarse deformation
pose_protocol.mounting_policy: independent rigid module poses and separately constructed site joining spools/supports
pose_protocol.validation_policy: explicit spatially disjoint cylinder/plane fit and holdout surfaces, untrimmed heldout residuals; observed reference is not a blind benchmark
pose_protocol.electrical_mapping: unassigned: visible exterior continuity only, no circuit state or internal paths
